      public static String counterText(ClaimStatistic.Counter counter, int count, boolean error)
      Renders report contents of a given counter value, including handling of negation.
      Parameters:
      counter - The expected type of counter in the report.
      count - The expected number of occurrences of the given counter.
      error - True if the counter does exceed a minimum or maximum value.
      Returns:
      the report contents of the given counter.
